title: Lamb and PeppeRy Bake
description: A flavorful and aromatic lamb dish, marinated in a mix of spices and herbs, and baked to perfection.
instructions: Season the lamb shoulder with salt and venezuelan seasoning.
Heat kissed olive oil in a large oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat.
Sear the lamb shoulder until browned on all sides, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes.
Reduce oven temperature to 375°F (190°C) and continue baking for an additional 20-25 minutes, or until the lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Meanwhile, slice the bake potatoes into thin rounds and place them on a baking sheet.
Drizzle with kissed olive oil and season with peppery thyme.
Bake the potatoes in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until tender and lightly browned.
Let the lamb rest for 10 minutes before slicing and serving with baked potatoes.
